_comment: Which pixelfx effects tools/make_pixelfx.mjs bakes into assets/fx/ + pixelfx-data.js. id: pixelfx effect id; as: our name (default: the id); opts: the effect's own options (palette, size, ...); warm: seconds simulated before the first frame (loops that build up, e.g. a fireball's tail); maxSec / fadeSec: stop early, fading out over the last fadeSec (long smoke tails do not fit a ~1 s turn); fps: frames per second (default the effect own); margin: px of room around the effect box (default 12) for tails that spill out.
